history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

4.2.6-reborn-rust-main-6101ca01.label: borg-reborn-rs 6101ca01, main at the merge of #525, after #527 (the named list as data) and the owner's switch of caution_scary_named_monsters back to 1 (#533). harness/borg.txt 77be6709... ships cornered mode on (#504), breeder boost 5, the named list on with the damage rule at 60, the borg-rs core and no plan or scary-list file.

experiment.description: Does cornered mode, and its radius and big-monster margin, change how current main survives? Generated from definitions/reborn-cornered-pilot.yaml: 8 arms on 4.2.6-reborn-rust-main-6101ca01, suite classes-18.

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-18: the owner asked for an experiment of cornered mode on the current build (borg-zoo#224), as caution_cornered (0,1) x caution_cornered_radius (2,3) x caution_cornered_big_level_margin (0,1). Pilot first (RULES 16).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-18, before any result was read (borg-zoo#224). Pilot only. Gate: no config_error; one binary; the
cornered lines written in each arm; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls, purchase bursts and
key outliers listed. Descriptive: deaths and causes per class (CL1-3 deaths counted), mean max level and depth;
paired rescued and newly killed against c0-r2-m0; the four c0 arms are expected to play identically (a check that radius and margin are inert with cornered off); from replays, cornered-mode notes (buffs, Monster Confusion)
in each arm. 18 starts per arm cannot show whether cornered mode helps.
